question: What is wrong with asking why one established in peaceful Shiva would descend again?
premises: The objection asks why one established in peaceful Shiva would descend again.
Such an objection assumes a fall from that establishment.
The objectors do not understand the ultimate reality of Śambhu.
inference: The objection is refuted because it misunderstands the Śaiva ultimate reality in which establishment in Shiva is not a reversible state.
plain_english: When one is established in peaceful Shiva, why would he descend again? Those who ask this are refuted from the outset, for they do not understand the ultimate reality of Śambhu.
